## Blood of the Buccaneers

Twice a man's height and built like a fortress, the Buccaneers were hunted almost to the last for the blood in their veins. The ones who are left do not fall easily.

Be of the Buccaneer race.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of the Buccaneer race

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

## Sorbet Kingdom

Bartholomew Kuma was a priest before he was a king, and a king before he was a weapon. He started in a small kingdom in the blues.

Reach 5,000 Doriki and visit a town in the blues.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Buccaneer Charge](r_buccaneer.md#q-46ab79afc709ce68)

**Tasks**

- Reach 5,000 Doriki
- Visit a town in your home sea

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, +4 Training Points (your race)

## The Tyrant

The Celestial Dragons kept Buccaneers as slaves and hunted them for sport at God Valley. Kuma walked out of Mary Geoise once. Some never did.

Go to Mary Geoise and set three prisoners free.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Answering Fist](r_buccaneer.md#q-2d85835734c9bb6f)

**Tasks**

- Visit Mary Geoise
- Free 3 prisoners

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +6 Training Points (your race)

## The Walk to Egghead

With no mind left of his own, Kuma walked across the world to save his daughter. His body remembered the way.

Reach 25,000 Doriki and visit ruins in the New World.

## The Unbreakable

- Reach 40,000 Doriki
- Defeat 40 hostiles in the New World

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +100,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +8 Training Points (your race)
